# ONNX export capability matrix (generated by scripts/gen_export_matrix.py)

121 operator URIs (textual scan; see script docstring). **66 forward operators** and **23 gradient operators** have ONNX lowerings; 32 have none (unsupported boundary, e.g. no VJP or no standard-op form). Gradient lowerings live on the gradient operators the autodiff emits (matmul_grad_lhs, conv2d_input_grad, layer_norm_grad, ...), so the forward/gradient columns are disjoint by construction. Opset column = minimum ONNX opset of the emitted op(s) as registered at the add() call.
